dedupe_keys.name: rustrino a rust native federated sql engine for production telecom network observability

description: Mehmet Fatih Yüce publishes benchmark artifacts for Rustrino, a federated SQL engine used in telecom-network observability. Zenodo lists two public archives under Apache 2.0. The description identifies per-configuration memory and render series, burst-latency percentiles, load and audit harnesses, and a synthetic 100-dashboard, 1,500-query corpus. A Docker Compose stack connects synthetic PostgreSQL, Quickwit, Prometheus and OpenAPI sources with an engine image and Grafana dashboards. These measurements can benchmark observability workloads or size monitoring infrastructure. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this synthetic benchmark. All released data are synthetic, not production operator telemetry. A limitation is that the own page says full engine source and deployment charts are to be released upon paper publication; this review does not claim they are already available. The paper status and image availability were not independently checked. Neither archive nor container image was downloaded or run, and performance measurements were not reproduced.
